answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 17 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. The oasis multiplier is published, charged in trellis, and crystal lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 2301 identities would post 2028 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
